info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the events industry, equipping students with the knowledge and skills required to plan and execute successful events. Students will explore the key characteristics of events, examine the role of industry bodies, and analyze the events business as a service industry. The course delves into the scope and impact of events on society, the economy, and politics, while offering a thorough understanding of event planning processes, including budgeting, marketing, and logistics. It places strong emphasis on strategic event management, project management techniques, and risk management strategies. A highlight of the course is the opportunity for hands-on experience through a real-world project, where students will apply their learning to organize a complete event.
info.studentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

2. Actively participate in class activities

3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

5. Read the textbook in advance

6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/gui/Home) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher after the course.

clos.loDetails: Identify the key characteristics of events, events industry bodies, in order to understand the business of events management as a service activity.
Comprehend the events industry's size, market dynamics, demand factors, and its societal, economic, political, technology influenced and developmental consequences.
The ability to conduct detailed planning, execute plans, manage risks, budgets, and teams, as well as evaluate outcomes for project success.
Understand the full lifecycle of event planning and execution from inception to completion.
Foster global citizenship by cultivating high ethical standards, individual strength, and a collaborative spirit.
